title: Classification of Digital Health Interventions v2 Display Values
description: Display values for Classification of Digital Health Interventions v2 ValueSet codes. Generated from FHIR expansions. Keys are code fragments (the part after '#' in the canonical IRI). The full IRI can be reconstructed as system + '#' + code.

fhir:displays.description: Multilingual display values for ValueSet codes keyed by code fragment
